title: Hobuck Beach Resort

services.name: North Cabins
services.desc: There are three styles of Hobuck Beach cabins located at the RV Park facilities at the south end of Hobuck Beach. These cabins have the best view of the Pacific Ocean. There is access to the beach and Hobuck Creek from this end of the resort. Up to six (6) people can be accommodated in the loft cabins. We have one wheelchair accessible cabin (#22), available upon request. Pets/service animals are not permitted in these cabins. Enjoy the sunset from the deck of your cabin. These eight cabins are best for four (4) or fewer occupants. They are located in row facing southwest located close to the bathhouse with showers.
